label_policy: 90 machine-verified source-anchor known items; 30 unverified question/paraphrase/broad/multi-document candidates. No human gold labels. Anchor metrics are silver known-item diagnostics, not semantic recall.
limitations: Exact-anchor known-item labels are machine verified, not human gold or exhaustive legal relevance. Unverified semantic and multi-document candidates have latency/results only. PostgreSQL simple lexemes have no morphology, semantic equivalence or reranking; deterministic ID ordering is the baseline.
